function.name: list_periods

function.name: compute_change
function.description: Compute the absolute and year-over-year change for one SEC EDGAR XBRL metric. The period and base_period must be the same kind of period; when base_period is omitted, null, empty, "null", or "none", use the same quarter or fiscal year one year earlier. function.name: history_rank
function.description: Compare one quarter or fiscal-year fact with every available comparable period of the same period_type. Return the rank, record flags through the requested period, prior high/low, and the comparison window with period end dates. The requested period also includes compact fact provenance and evidence strength.
